sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation Establishment and Actions Validating Ordinance 1962
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XVII OF 1962
ORDINANCE XVII OF 1962
WEST PAKISTAN SMALL INDUSTRIES CORPORATION
(ESTABLISHMENT AND ACTIONS) VALIDATING ORDINANCE, 1962
1. Short title
and commencement.‑(1) This Ordinance
may be called the West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation (Establishment and
Actions) Validating Ordinance, 1962.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

2. West Pakistan Ordinance x111 of 1960.‑All words and expressions
used herein and defined in the West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation
Ordinance, 1960 (hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance), shall be
deemed to have the meanings assigned to them by the said Ordinance.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation Establishment and Actions Validating Ordinance 1962
sections.description:
Regularization of appointments and discharges made and validation of actions taken and orders passed

ORDINANCE XVII OF 1962
ORDINANCE XVII OF 1962
WEST PAKISTAN SMALL INDUSTRIES CORPORATION
(ESTABLISHMENT AND ACTIONS) VALIDATING ORDINANCE, 1962
3.
Regularization of appointments and discharges made and validation of actions
taken and orders passed.‑Notwithstanding anything contained in the
said Ordinance‑--
(a) the
West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation (hereinafter referred to as the said
Corporation) shall be deemed to have been validity estab lished on the 30th
April, 1960, in accordance with the provisions of sub section (1) of section 3 of the said Ordinance ;
(b) every person who‑
(i) was appointed a Director or
Chairman of the Board of Directors 0 the said Corporation, or
(ii) ceased to be a Director or
Chairman of the Board of Directors of the said Corporation, on or after the
30th April, 1960, and before the commencement of this Ordinance, shall be
deemed validly to have been so appointed, or so ceased to be, as the case may
be, in accordance with the provisions of the said Ordi nance ; and
(e) everything done, action taken or orders passed by
the Government or the said Corporation or the Chairman of the Board of
Directors, or a Director of the said Corporation, in exercise of the powers
vested in Government or the Corporation or the Chairman of the Board or the Director,
as the case may be, under the said Ordinance on or after the 30th April, 1960,
and before the commencement of this Ordinance, shall be deemed to have been
validly done, taken or passed.
